text:
Devin R: Quick async check — can owners confirm status on the Dedicated capacity buildout for Q2? Need procurement ETA, cluster readiness, and any blockers for the capacity reservations we're committing to.
Maria L: Owning the infra rollout piece. GPU arrival dates look OK but rack+power scheduling got delayed 24-48h. Working with facilities to firm up Thursday.
Priya K: Procurement here — vendor confirmed H100 shipment final manifest. ETA to datacenter is Wed 06:00 UTC, customs cleared. Need final invoice signoff from finance to release allocation. @Nate B can you confirm?
Nate B: Finance — I have the PO and approvals queued. One open item: we need the reserved capacity SLO for Dedicated customers (latency SLA) to finalize the cost center mapping. Can someone paste the SLO text?
Sofia M: From product/ML side: target config is 8xH100 per tenant pool, 32GB per GPU, NVLink enablement. SLO we promised is 99.9% p99 < 120ms for single-request inference under 8qps steady-state. Is that what you need?
Nate B: Yes that's perfect, thanks. Will attach to the invoice approval.
Kevin S: SRE checking in: current cluster image and node boot scripts are in the infra repo, but we found a missing kernel module for NVLink on the preloaded image. I've filed a PR (link: https://git.internal/r/infra/boot-scripts/pull/289) to include the driver and systemd unit. Need a quick review from @Maria L.
Maria L: Looking now. If PR looks good we can push an image build tonight and schedule a canary deploy to the staging rack. Can anyone run the hardware precheck once racks are powered? infra-bot, can we run health-check on `rack-eu-3` once power is live?
infra-bot: scheduled health-check job for rack-eu-3 at 2026-06-04T02:00:00Z. Results will be posted to this thread.
Devin R: Blockers: 1) power scheduling delay (Maria), 2) invoice signoff (Nate), 3) kernel module PR review (Maria/infra). Anything else?
Priya K: Customs cleared, so procurement is green. ETA to rack is Wed morning. I'll hold shipment release until finance confirms.
Kevin S: One more dependency — network team needs to confirm metal LB capacity and BGP sessions for the new node pool. Tagged network in the PR, but if anyone has a direct contact ping them please.
Sofia M: Also flagging model onboarding: we need a small perf eval after canary to validate p99 numbers. I'll prepare a perf prompt set and baseline script.
Maria L: Quick checklist I'm tracking: 1) Power schedule confirmed (pending facilities ok Thu) 2) New image build with NVLink drivers (in progress) 3) Node boot test (after image) 4) Network LB + BGP (blocking if not done) 5) Post-canary perf eval.
Devin R: Can we get owners and ETA in-line? I'll add to the shared project board.
Priya K: Procurement: ETA Wed 06:00 UTC -> holding shipment until finance signoff (Nate).
Nate B: Finance: ETA for signoff today EOD if SLO text attached (done).
Maria L: Infra: image build tonight, canary deploy Thu 03:00 UTC if facilities confirms power by Thu 00:00 UTC.
Kevin S: SRE/Network: can we get network confirmation by Thu 01:00 UTC? I'll follow up with @tyler-net offline.
Sofia M: ML: perf eval ready — will run within 2 hours of canary and post results.
Devin R: Great. If all goes to plan we can flip capacity reservations and update Dedicated dashboard Friday morning. I'll update the board and tag owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: health-check for rack-eu-3 completed. Summary: 6/6 PDUs online, 8/8 nodes responsive, NVLink driver detected on nodes-1..4 (nodes-5..8 pending image update). Full log: https://logs.internal/health/rack-eu-3/1763001234
Kevin S: infra-bot looks promising. Nodes 5..8 still need the image push — Maria once image is built I can kick off the boot validation and then schedule network config.
Maria L: Will push image by 22:00 UTC tonight. Noted for canary Thursday.
Devin R: OK — I'll close this async check-in. If anything slips, please post here. Otherwise we'll aim to have reservations committed by Friday 08:00 UTC.
Sofia M: I'll post perf results here after canary.
Priya K: Noted. I'll queue release once Nate confirms payment capture.
Nate B: Payment capture confirmed, procurement can go ahead.
Devin R: Thanks everyone.
